title: Plantilla del Curso: Advanced Machine Learning
summary: A university course template repository for an Advanced Machine Learning final project, containing a student notebook that preprocesses a tabular dataset and generates synthetic records for missing category combinations. The notebook imports and runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a Metadata schema, conditional sampling, and evaluate_quality to synthesize and assess the data.
needs: Domain/industry of the underlying dataset is not identifiable from the evidence; classified as cross_industry.
